THIS TRIP

10 days in Tour du Mont Blanc trek, built around scenic viewpoints, hiking and geology and geothermal.

Following the trail from bed to bed: Les Houches → Les Contamines-Montjoie → Les Chapieux → Courmayeur. Each move is that day's walk, with the bags sent ahead.

WHAT THIS PLAN STILL LACKS

Three-country village overnights is not in the plan, although the board offers it. Sleeping in French, Italian and Swiss villages along the route is what makes this a point-to-point trek rather than a single base trip. Keep one of La Fouly to Champex-Lac on the Discovery Board and rebuild.

SIGNATURE EXPERIENCES

The trip is built around
I · DAY 2
Mer de Glace (Montenvers)
Cog railway up to France's largest glacier, a good half-day once the trek ends and legs need a rest.
II · DAY 3
Les Houches to Les Contamines-Montjoie
Opening TMB stage over Col de Tricot (~16km, 1100m climb) with views of the Bionnassay glacier, a strong first test of the group's pace.
III · DAY 9
Chamonix
Holds up even if the weather turns.

Stays quiet even in season, which matters more to you than a famous name.
